we are able to train an RL policy on a real target environment by using a simulator that is learned to match an offline dataset from that environment.
we propose a novel framework for offline reinforcement learning, called OTED, that leverages offline data and a simulator to train a reinforcement learning agent.

simulators can help bridge the sim2real divide even when the offline data is limited.
